problemSigns.sign: Loading dock door stuck open or closed
problemSigns.detail: A commercial loading dock door that will not move stops your business. This impacts deliveries, shipments, and overall workflow. It can also be a security problem if left open.

problemSigns.sign: Rolling steel curtain off its guides
problemSigns.detail: If your rolling steel curtain has jumped its tracks, it will not operate correctly. This leaves your facility vulnerable. It also damages the curtain and its guide rails over time.
A burned-out operator motor means your commercial door will not open or close automatically. This requires manual operation, slowing down your business. It also indicates a component failure.

problemSigns.sign: High-cycle springs at end of life
problemSigns.detail: Commercial high-cycle springs are rated for many thousands of cycles. Over time, these springs lose tension or break. This makes the door very heavy and unsafe to operate. It needs immediate replacement.
